market.label: What the site sells or does

steps.title: Audit one area
steps.prompt: Crawl data: {{run.dir}}/site-crawl.json. Market: {{inputs.market}}. You are audit lane {{index}} of 0 to 4: 0 technical, 1 on-page, 2 schema, 3 content, 4 images. Audit only your area from the crawl data. Write {{run.dir}}/audit-{{index}}.json as a list of findings with severity, title, page and detail. Set the output key findings to that path. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Rank the fixes
steps.prompt: Findings: {{steps.audit.outputs.findings}}. Merge them into one list ranked by impact over effort and write {{run.dir}}/FIXES.md, one line per fix with the file it touches. Name the three key pages for the speed check. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Fix on a new branch
steps.prompt: Apply {{run.dir}}/FIXES.md in this worktree, top down. One commit per area on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Lighthouse the key pages
steps.prompt: Build and serve the site from this folder and run Lighthouse on these key pages: {{steps.prioritise.outputs.key_pages}}. Fix what holds performance under 90 and commit on the current branch. Do not push. Append each page score to {{run.dir}}/speed.md. Set passed to true when every key page scores 90 or more, otherwise false.

steps.title: Approve the deploy
steps.gate_summary: Fixes: {{steps.fix.outputs.summary}}. Speed: {{steps.speed.outputs.scores}}. Approve to deploy {{steps.fix.outputs.branch}} to production.
